summary.LABEL: V34_W1_CAUSAL_BLEED_CENSUS
summary.binding: V34-W1 causal e56d79a2 STRICT_EVENT_LEDGER; the 254 = STRICT completed pairs.
summary.method: Per non-254 game, ONE primary bleed mechanism by causal priority. na=credited count. na==2 (both filled, over par): TAKE_PREEMPT if a credited leg regret>=2c vs its qualifying floor (a later shelf existed) else CAP_STRANGLED. na==1: NAKED_PAIR (blocker=uncredited leg) with sub-mechanism NO_OFFER(blocker had no floor)/CAP_STRANGLED(blocker floor+filled entry>=100)/REST_STARVED(resting_at_hard_edge or RESTING/NEVER_RECEIVED terminal)/STATE_MISLABEL(takeable qualified ask<=cap but SETTLED-share<10% so state forbade the take)/OTHER. na==0: NO_OFFER(a leg never offered a floor)/CAP_STRANGLED(floors sum>=100)/REST_STARVED/STATE_MISLABEL/ZERO_FILL.
